question: How would Theresia and Wilhelm react if they figured out that they both had fallen in love at first sight?
answer: If Wilhelm figured out that they both fell in love at first sight, he would probably die. Wilhelm actually thinks that she had no interest in him at the beginning, but doing all sorts of things made her come to him, so he often worries if Theresia became happy after getting together with him. Thus, if Wilhelm found that out, he would die. Both in a good way and a bad way.
